channel.title: The Oakland Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Oakland Press (theoaklandpress.com)

item.title: Michigan would regulate police license plate cameras under bipartisan bill
item.description: At least 16 states have adopted policies aimed at regulating the use and retention of data collected by license plate readers, which capture pictures of vehicle license plates every time a car drives by. Some lawmakers want Michigan, where 125 agencies contract with Flock, to do the same.

item.title: Black fathers embrace resources to support their pregnant partners through birth
item.description: The maternal mortality rate for Black women soars above that of other racial groups.

item.title: This smoky lentil sloppy joes packs in the plant-based protein and demands napkins
item.description: This recipe is from the “I Love Sandwiches” chapter in my cookbook “Eat to Hustle.”

item.title: Accessible walks bring the joys of birding to people with mobility and other limitations
item.description: It’s part of a growing national movement.

item.title: ‘I was going to die’: People describe terror as reported tornado descends on Three Rivers
item.description: As the skies cleared, people emerged to overturned cars, downed power lines, scraps of metal and varying other debris.

item.title: Travel: Winter in Vienna is the season for music and fancy balls
item.description: I'd been to Vienna once, four decades ago, loved it and always meant to go back. But would it be worth it to go in winter, when it's freezing cold?

item.title: Eastern Michigan, Western Michigan fire basketball coaches on same day after last-place MAC finishes
item.description: Eastern Michigan and Western Michigan fired their basketball coaches on the same day, parting ways with former assistants under Michigan State coach Tom Izzo.

item.title: Yaxel Lendeborg scores 27, No. 3 Michigan beats No. 8 Michigan State 90-80 to sweep season series
item.description: Yaxel Lendeborg scored 19 of his 27 points in the first half and Morez Johnson Jr. finished with 18 points, leading No. 3 Michigan in a 90-80 win over No. 8 Michigan State on Sunday to give the Big Ten champions a 15th straight conference win.

item.title: Herro scores 25, Adebayo hits milestone and Heat top Pistons 121-110, Detroit’s 4th straight loss
item.description: Tyler Herro scored 25 points, Bam Adebayo had 24 to go over the 10,000-point mark for his career, and the Miami Heat beat Detroit 121-110 on Sunday night to extend the Pistons’ season-worst losing streak to four games.

item.title: Gibson and Talbot combine to make 31 saves in the Red Wings’ 3-0 win over the Devils
item.description: John Gibson and Cam Talbot combined to make 31 saves, Dominik Shine scored his first NHL goal and the Detroit Red Wings beat the New Jersey Devils 3-0 on Sunday night.
